description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki Samurai Rear Axle Bearing and Oil Seal Repair Kit.
It does BOTH SIDES.
You get everything you need to complete the repair on both axles.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Bearings (LH & RH)
Qty 2 – Oil Seals (LH & RH)
Qty 2 – Retainer Ring, Oil Seals (LH & RH)
Qty 2 – Protectors, Oil Seals (LH & RH)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1986-1995
Suzuki SJ413 1985-1995
